card.name: Words pointing the reader elsewhere
card.fires_on: Words in referral phrases that send the reader to another source, such as "see" before boxed WARNINGS, "Refer to" the prescribing information, or "Consult with pharmacist". Also "If you use/are able" style lead-ins to an instruction.

modes.label: See / Refer cross-references
modes.description: The word see or refer (or the following to/of) that points to another section or document.

modes.description: Words in a phrase telling the reader to consult someone or act if able, such as pharmacist or "If you".
